notes.title: Bring the mayhem: Bullet Runner's Demo Out NOW & full release in November!
notes.notes:
Here we go then, Bullet Runner is ready, and you better get ready to rumble!

On November 14, 2024, Bullet Runner is coming out on PC, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. The game is ready, it's beautifully boomer, it's a shooter that'll keep your blood pressure climbing higher and higher.

Bullet Runner is a boomer shooter. Twin-stick shooter. Shooter. Full 10 hours of explosive action with baddies - massive armies of enemies swarming all over you and your mission is a simple one: destroy them all.

Check out our brand-new trailer to dive into the story and world of Bullet Runner:

[previewyoutube=o4REgRj1SpA;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll have an arsenal of weapons, like shotguns, pistols, snipers, bazookas... And your fists. When your ammo and health are out, beat and kick the living .... out of your enemies and you're going again. Oh, and there's special moves and of course epic parkour to make it all more difficult. 

We'll promise you this: we did not make this an too easy of an game for you.

Too tired of waiting any more? We just released a demo for you to get going! Get your demo here and start honing your skills:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899850/Bullet_Runner_Demo/

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Fixes and changes
notes.notes:
Welcome to our second devlog! 
We are very happy that you are here :)


This time we focused on improving the mechanics and objects in the game!
We paid a lot of attention to optimization and balance in the arenas, which will make the gameplay much more enjoyable.

Here are the results of our work:


Increased the weapon slot count from two to six

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628292/0129805b1ac6bfea2cdc4b2816225ae413da38fb.png

The balanced arenas provide a smoother difficulty curve also in the first tiers. Whereas
lighting improvements, make the smoothness of various materials and metals look so much better!

[previewyoutube=i_6HqqOH1AE;full][/previewyoutube]


We also want to thank everyone who added our game to their Steam wishlist and encourage those who haven't already! :D
This motivates us to continue working on the project :)

We also invite you to our Discord channel, where there are new information about the game and more!


Discord : https://discord.gg/QTma5gypU5

Thank you and see you soon,
Bullet Runner Team.
